question: Should this maintainer-labeled Matrix cleanup proceed after a complete source-and-history review confirms the SDK helper is behaviorally identical for all affected paths?
rationale: The repository policy requires a whole-surface review, but the read-only environment prevented that verification; the item is also maintainer-authored and protected from automatic cleanup.

options.title: Retry complete review
options.body: Restore read-only repository inspection and compare the shared helper contract, Matrix callers, tests, scoped policy, and feature history before deciding.

options.title: Review in the Matrix area
options.body: Have a Matrix-area reviewer confirm the helper contract and then decide whether the cleanup is ready to merge.

recommendation.title: Retry complete review
